SELECT 
    c.namelabel AS constructor_name,
    COUNT(cr.cresref) AS total_races_started,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cr.st_mark IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS total_races_finished,
    ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN cr.st_mark IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS numeric) / COUNT(cr.cresref) * 100, 2) AS reliability_percentage
FROM constructor_results cr
JOIN constructors c ON cr.unitnode = c.cstr_key
GROUP BY c.namelabel
HAVING COUNT(cr.cresref) > 10
ORDER BY reliability_percentage DESC;

    constructor_name,
    total_races_started,
    total_races_finished,
    reliability_percentage,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY reliability_percentage DESC) AS reliability_rank
FROM (
    SELECT 
        c.namelabel AS constructor_name,
        COUNT(cr.cresref) AS total_races_started,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN cr.st_mark IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS total_races_finished,
        ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN cr.st_mark IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS numeric) / COUNT(cr.cresref) * 100, 2) AS reliability_percentage
    FROM constructor_results cr
    JOIN constructors c ON cr.unitnode = c.cstr_key
    GROUP BY c.namelabel
    HAVING COUNT(cr.cresref) > 10
) sub
ORDER BY reliability_rank;
